name: heat-gate
description: Keeps parallel Claude Code sessions from cooking your laptop: live CPU temperature above the prompt, a shared queue for heavy builds, and an emergency freeze before a thermal shutdown

language.title: Language
language.description: Language of the band, the pane and the messages

hold_above.title: Hold builds from (°C)
hold_above.description: Linux: a heavy build waits in the queue when the CPU is at or above this temperature. macOS follows the thermal pressure instead

release_below.title: Release below (°C)
release_below.description: Linux: a queued build starts once the CPU is below this temperature and no other build runs

freeze_enabled.title: Emergency freeze
freeze_enabled.description: Pause build processes with SIGSTOP when the CPU gets close to a thermal shutdown

freeze_at.title: Freeze at (°C)
freeze_at.description: Linux: temperature that triggers the emergency freeze. macOS freezes when the thermal pressure is high

thaw_below.title: Resume below (°C)
thaw_below.description: Linux: frozen builds resume once the CPU is below this temperature

max_wait_minutes.title: Maximum wait (minutes)
max_wait_minutes.description: A queued build is refused after waiting this long

extra_build_pattern.title: Extra build pattern
extra_build_pattern.description: Optional regular expression for more commands to treat as heavy builds, such as make -j|ninja
